# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 13 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Devout and the Sinners

---

**13:1** Do not scorn us, O God, when we cry out to you
in affliction and misery.

**13:2** The right hand of the LORD covers us as a shield;
the hand of the LORD is over us for good.

**13:3** The LORD's rod of chastisement is upon the devout in loving correction;
he leads them to the life of God.

**13:4** The devout of the LORD will live by it forever;
the trees of life in the LORD's Paradise are his devout ones.

**13:5** Their planting is rooted forever;
they shall not be uprooted for all the days of heaven.

**13:6** For the portion and inheritance of God is Israel.

**13:7** But it is not so with sinners and transgressors,
who love only the season of their sinful company;

**13:8** their delight is in fleeting corruption,
and they do not keep God in mind.

**13:9** For the ways of men are known before the LORD,
and he knows what the heart holds before it is revealed.

**13:10** Therefore their inheritance is Hades, darkness, and destruction;
they shall not be found in the day when the righteous receive mercy.

**13:11** But the devout of the LORD shall inherit life in gladness.

**13:12** Our life is in the love of God forever;
we set our hope in him for all eternity.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA.*
